objective: Measure the first real routing treatment: capacity-aware next-hop selection versus hop-shortest routing under the fixed 100 Mbps M-Lab burst profile.
context: This is a descriptive congestion and link-utilization diagnostic, not a final algorithm claim.
Both cells share the same trace seed and measured endpoint input; only routing.policy changes from hop to capacity.
The run is intended to expose whether queue/rate-aware routing changes delivery and utilization before learning experiments.
deliverables: A persisted V2 paired analysis for delivery_rate
cannot_claim: Paper-ready statistical conclusion from one seed
acceptance: Matrix identity and exact intervention path pass independent review.
Both cells complete naturally on one clean deployed SHA with conservation and acceptance true.
V2 analysis recomputes the paired delivery_rate difference from raw receipts; any utilization interpretation remains diagnostic until separately reviewed.
